primary_population: existing fixed pilot: all 640 forward prefixes, 128 families per split; no GT eligibility filtering
development: existing Train internal Dev; freeze all selected configurations before Seen evaluation
head: existing aerial_city_adapt/best_dev.pt; no new training

calibration.selection: forward Dev Goal R1, net recovery, fewer damages, smaller gain, current-only, lexical configuration tie

oracle: target identity only sets instance evidence; association uses public polygons, observed footprints, original geometry logits; never use target coordinates to select cells

observation.ranking: public frozen static logits; active top8 belief*(1-observed confidence); actions never access target IDs/coordinates
observation.semantics: new views are actual environment-rendered RGB/depth at legal visited virtual poses, not recorded human flights; coverage-only, no backbone re-encoding or navigation training

quality: existing select_regions min_visible0.9,min_pixels256,min_side8,RGB support0.9,patch support0.9,max32; unchanged; additionally report depth valid >=0.9 without changing legacy eligibility

gates.mapping: all synthetic tests; unknown residual exactly zero
gates.oracle: recovery count >0 among static errors with observed target; compare centroid
gates.real_independent: real>zero and real>shuffled Goal R1; paired map CI lower >0 for both
gates.localization: real-geometry Goal R1 >=0.01 and paired map CI lower >0
gates.active: same 2-action budget credible target coverage>hold; paired map CI lower>0

stop: no fusion training if Oracle fails; no new backbone/GAT/navigation/Unseen this round; propose closedloop only if localization and independent RGB gates pass
